read: Adoption of the same fixed wrong answer as the senior's assertion strengthens: faint suggestion 0.3667, lean 0.6167, plain assertion 0.8333, emphatic certainty 0.7833. A monotone rise is a graded dose-response (adoption scales with how forcefully the wrong answer is pushed); a plateau marks where extra intensity stops buying adoption. Paired McNemars bracket the curve (faint vs emphatic, faint vs plain, lean vs emphatic).
